title: Growth family selector usability audit

findings.evidence: growAgain() begins with if(layer!=="L1")return, while L2 narrative families are public and the button is not disabled for L2.
findings.effect: The visible 同段階で別案 button can do nothing in L2.

findings.evidence: populateGrowthFamilies() appends every matching family directly to one select. L2/all therefore presents 40 flat options.
findings.effect: Users must scan a long ungrouped list even though dimension metadata already exists.

findings.evidence: Family option text is always [dimension] + label, even after the user has already selected a single dimension.
findings.effect: In 引用・伝聞, 22 options repeat the same dimension label and hide the distinguishing part of the family name.

findings.evidence: Dimension options show only names, not how many families they contain.
findings.effect: Users cannot see before selecting that 引用・伝聞 contains 22 choices while several other dimensions contain only one.

findings.evidence: The family selector does not show stage count.
findings.effect: A 4-stage family and a 17-stage family look equally large until selected.

strengths_to_preserve: Type -> information dimension -> family is the right three-level conceptual hierarchy.
Dimension filtering already reduces L1 well.
Native select controls remain touch-friendly and keyboard-accessible.
No family needs deletion to solve the usability issue.
recommended_changes: Show family counts in dimension labels.
When dimension=all, group family options by dimension with optgroup.
When one dimension is selected, omit the redundant [dimension] prefix.
Append stage count to each narrative family option.
Retain current family selection when a repopulation still contains it.
Make 同段階で別案 work for narrative mode on L2; keep structural reroll L1-only.
Disable 同段階で別案 when no same-filter alternative has the requested stage.
non_goals: Do not remove or merge the 53 families.
Do not introduce a custom searchable dropdown yet.
Do not change growth sentence data or palindrome readings.
